answer_requirements.rule: When a user asks for evidence, source, original text, commentary, or notes, the visible draft_answer must include a readable text cue or short quote from at least one card for each requested evidence type; a source title or generic source-layer label alone is not sufficient.

entity_intro.fate_later_forty_opening: 按后四十回范围看，当前证据能直接支持的是：
entity_intro.fate_default_boundary: 这些材料可以说明文本中的命运线索；更完整的终局叙事仍需要继续命中对应情节。
entity_intro.fate_later_forty_boundary: 这些材料必须标注为后四十回内容；它们可以说明该版本中的后续遭际，不能回推为前八十回正文或脂批范围内的确定结论。

entity_intro.rule: For entity/person introduction questions, compose from multiple readable in-package evidence cards when available; skip short speech-shell fragments and narrative transition formulae in favor of substantive passages, and state the evidence boundary instead of writing a biography from outside the package.

chapter_location.no_evidence_template: 请再明确要定位的情节口径。当前材料没有命中能把“{event}”定位到具体回目的可用材料，不能改答成人物介绍。
chapter_location.ambiguous_template: 当前材料把“{event}”相关线索命中到多个回目：{locations}。请明确你要问的是正面情节发生回目，还是文本中出现/追提该线索的回目。
chapter_location.rule: For chapter-location questions, answer the chapter number first. Prefer chapter heading/title and direct base-text evidence. Commentary may be visible only when the quote itself explains the location or title relation; do not cite isolated local comments that do not explain what they support.

attribute_age.rule: For age attribute questions, extract explicit age cues near the requested entity, allow bounded inference only from in-package age cues, and label event-time or comparison answers as inference unless the package directly fixes the exact age.

rationale_followup.rule: When a user asks a follow-up about reasoning, logic, basis, or why an earlier answer was inferred, answer by explaining the evidence chain and uncertainty boundary instead of restating the original conclusion.
